name: Sand Hills Golf Club
centre_source: UNCONFIRMED: Stymie's map point (41.870339, -101.100577) for its 'Sand Hills Golf Club, Hwy 97 Mile Marker 55, Mullen' page, whose scorecard is another course's. DATA_REQUEST step 0 checks it against OSM before any download.
notable: Routed through natural sand blowouts in grass-covered dunes on an 8,000-acre site where the architects found 130 possible holes (golfcoursegurus)
golfcoursegurus: 3rd in Nebraska, 39th in the US, 30th in North America (that site's own lists); the national magazine rankings were not checked
video_games: Not checked (scouting's web-search budget ran out). No official appearance known.
tees_note: GolfPass tee table. Its per-hole rows (labelled Black/White/Red) add to 7,073 / 6,434 / 5,052; hole 15 Diamond 453 there vs 469 in a review explains the Diamond gap.
wind_note: proposed new 'plains' band: open grass-covered dunes with no shelter; a golf-season mean of about 10 mph (regional climatology from memory, unverified); calm rounds rare. Between open coast (3-14) and Bandon (8-16).
special_ground: unmaintained blowout sand outside play, if OSM maps it as natural=sand: waste (surface 18, "waste_sand": true)
water: none known on the course (no source mentions a pond or creek); confirm in OSM and the photo
